mentions.name: FitCal
mentions.description: This app syncs Strava activities to a Google calendar, so completed workouts appear as calendar events alongside planned training, letting users see their workout history and consistency over time at a glance. Built with Elixir and Phoenix.
mentions.problem: Workouts uploaded to Garmin and Strava didn't show up back in the user's calendar, making it hard to see training consistency over time at a glance.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://fitcal.app syncs Strava activities to your Google calendar.  No fancy features, just does what it says on the tin.

evidence.value: https://fitcal.app syncs Strava activities to your Google calendar.  No fancy features, just does what it says on the tin.
